Hexalith.EventStore.ServiceDefaults.Routing.RouteCatalogUnavailableException: The query response disagrees with its committed projection identity.
diagnosis: A computed query returns QueryType in QueryResult.ProjectionType; the committed computed route declares no projection identity. DaprDomainQueryInvoker rejects the mismatch.
